meta.title: Plugin online updates
meta.description: Open Plugin online updates in the left sidebar, click Check all updates, select compatible stable releases, then review Update selected. Choose the task policy before confirming: wait for current tasks to finish naturally by default, or separately and explicitly approve stopping every running Agent task in this profile and clearing queued input before waiting for admitted work to settle. Save work first; completed operations cannot be undone. External terminals and independent Workers are never killed. DSH is not automatically exited or restarted. The WSL 0.24.0 to 0.26.2 runtime-generation update is verified: original JS/assets remain unchanged, independent paths and retained resources avoid stale generations, and Host rows are checked afterward. Existing sessions may retain their prior preset; immediate migration is not promised. Unverified future releases and Host core components still require independent handling; official components are managed with the Host version. The updater can be confirmed separately for official Host handoff under the narrow public npm policy or this fixed public GitHub repository at a full commit. GitHub main is not a release channel; dependencies follow current Host registry settings and installation/recovery can fail. Its old gate ends at unload, not after the entire replacement. The panel retains per-plugin outcomes, recovery details, sanitized local history and auxiliary read-only file-use evidence. Version discovery reuses DSH's query source; staging is limited to the public official npm registry and replacement uses verified local archives. Private, Git and linked development sources are not automatically migrated. Local diagnostics are not uploaded.
